alphamissense.variance_check_note: Gaussian large-sample Monte Carlo approximation; the finite-population variance oracle itself is exact
alphamissense.interpretation: Conditional label-destruction pipeline control; no exchangeability-based claim about original observational scores

candidate_impact_counts.definition: Outer K/R gain whose score is below the measured same-site uncharged-alternative mean
candidate_impact_counts.count_population: All eligible outer sites, not only sites in two-sided matched strata
candidate_impact_counts.interpretation: Counts of relative score-pattern candidates, not confirmed insertion defects, reversed internal rules, clinical errors or patients
